attchmntText: GPT Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange about Alcon Builders & Engineers Private Limited (WOS) of GPT Infraprojects Limited for being declared as L1 (Lowest First) in order valued at Rs. 103.58 Crore.
voiceSummary: GPT Infraprojects Limited announces that its wholly owned subsidiary, Alcon Builders and Engineers Private Limited, has been declared L1 in an order valued at Rs. 103.58 Crore. The client is CSTE, North Eastern Railway. The contract involves the design, programming, installation, supply, testing, and commissioning of an Electronic Interlocking System conforming to RDSO Specification No. RDSO/SPN/192/2019. Work includes indoor and outdoor activities at multiple stations in the Varanasi Division of N.E. Railway. It also covers automatic block signaling work in the CPR Jn-CI-CHPG Block Section and OFC cables in the GKC-BTT and CPR Jn-CI-CHPG Sections. The company requests the exchanges to take note of this development.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30,2026
voiceSummary: Paramount Communications Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from a preferential issue of equity shares and fully convertible warrants. The total issue size was Rs. 122.63 crore, comprising Rs. 92.39 crore for equity shares and Rs. 30.24 crore for warrants. The company utilized Rs. 73.39 crore during the quarter as per the offer document objectives. No deviation from the objects was reported. The monitoring agency noted that the Chartered Accountant certificate dated October 26, 2026, did not include the auditor's responsibility report, meaning it did not explicitly provide assurance on the utilization of funds. The information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: The Hi-Tech Gears Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: The Hi-Tech Gears Limited filed an earnings presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated operational income for Q2 FY27 was INR 2850 Mn, up 18.4% year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at INR 107 Mn, a 78.3% increase. Diluted EPS was INR 5.68. For H1 FY27, consolidated operational income was INR 5227 Mn, up 14.6% year-on-year. Profit after tax was INR 155 Mn, up 29.2%. Diluted EPS was INR 8.21. The company reported zero net debt to equity as of H1 FY27. It operates five manufacturing plants in India, Canada, and the USA. The firm supplies components to automotive original equipment manufacturers including Hero MotoCorp, Mahindra, and Daimler.

attchmntText: Kalyani Forge Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Kalyani Forge Limited filed the transcript of its Analyst and Investor Conference Call held on November 06, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The call discussed financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Managing Director Viraj G. Kalyani announced a board-approved Rs. 45 crore funding plan comprising Rs. 10 crore equity, Rs. 20 crore debt, and up to Rs. 20 crore from non-core asset and inventory monetization. First half of FY27 Profit Before Tax rose 118% year-on-year to Rs. 9.39 crore, while Profit After Tax increased 86% to Rs. 6.64 crore. Second quarter EBITDA margin stood at 14.2%, marking the fourth consecutive quarter above this threshold. Truck segment sales surged 75% year-on-year to Rs. 23.3 crore, representing 43% of total sales. Revenue declined 18% sequentially to Rs. 54.4 crore due to planned downtime from reconditioning a 2,500-ton press and relocating the driveline machining plant. Receivables increased due to delayed remittances during a banking changeover. The company is normalizing collections and expanding capacity for new engine and wheel hub orders.

attchmntText: Shekhawati Industries Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
voiceSummary: Shekhawati Industries Limited received no-objection letters from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for the reclassification of Altius Buildcon Private Limited from the Promoter Group category to the Public category. The exchanges granted this no-objection based on the company's application dated September 17, 2026. The reclassification is effective from November 09, 2026. Copies of the no-objection letters from both exchanges are enclosed with the announcement.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its Q2 and FY27 unaudited financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The company reported an export revenue share of 81.3% for Q2 FY27. It commenced commercial production at its new Al Juba facility in Oman during the quarter. The firm secured US FDA facility registration for its Oman and Mangaluru facilities. Mukka Proteins holds approximately 25 to 30% market share in fish meal and fish oil revenue. The company targets revenue growth from 1,449 crore rupees in FY26 to over 3,000 crore rupees by FY30. It operates 18 owned in-house production facilities in India and Oman. The presentation highlights a strategic shift toward an integrated animal protein and sustainability platform.

attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE on 10th November 2026. The call was held on 6th November 2026. Management reported improved yarn business performance driven by higher demand, rising yarn prices, and trading gains from low-cost cotton purchases. Current cotton landed costs are approximately INR65,000 per candy. The fabric business faced challenges due to lower export volumes, tariff uncertainty, and higher input costs. The company expects improved order pipelines following US election results. An open-end yarn project with a capacity of 50 tons per day is expected to be operational in six to seven months. No major capital expenditure plans for the spinning business have been announced for the next two years.

attchmntText: Platinum Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Platinum Industries Limited filed a transcript of its post-earnings conference call held on 05th November, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 121.3 crores for Q2 FY27, up from INR 98.4 crores in Q2 FY26. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 7.6 crores. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue stood at INR 230.20 crores, with profit after tax at INR 18.7 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansion in Palghar and an Egypt facility with increased capacity to 60,000 MTPA. Partial capacity in Egypt is expected by 31st December, 2026. Sales from Platinum Oleo chemicals reached INR 11.4 crores in Q2 FY27. The company noted rising ocean freight costs impacting margins but expects utilization improvements in the second half of FY27.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Trejhara Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants totaling Rs 162.17 crore. The issue period was from January 27, 2026, to February 10, 2026. The company has utilized Rs 50.44 crore, primarily for strategic acquisitions. Rs 111.73 crore remains unutilized as it is yet to be received from warrant holders. The report notes that the warrant conversion price of Rs 162.00 per share is higher than the closing market price of Rs 124.05 per share on October 15, 2026, posing a risk of non-exercise of conversion rights. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 6, 2026.

attchmntText: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call held on November 04, 2026. The company reported a standalone net profit of Rs. 1,881 crore for the quarter. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 33 per share. Borrowings decreased to Rs. 9,245 crore. The debt-equity ratio improved to 0.55. A fire incident at the Coker Hydrotreater Unit resulted in a provisional loss of Rs. 118.76 crore. Restoration is targeted by mid-December 2026. The company secured a BBB- credit rating from Fitch International. A refund of Rs. 212 crore was received regarding a tax dispute. Capex for FY 2026-27 is estimated between Rs. 1,200 crore and Rs. 1,500 crore. No unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the call.

attchmntText: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited received in-principal approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 09, 2026, for the proposed listing of Non-Convertible Securities issued on a private placement basis in various tranches. The approval is subject to adequate disclosures in the General Information Document dated November 06, 2026, and compliance with SEBI regulations. The Company must submit a valid credit rating letter prior to the issue opening and listing. Listing will occur after allotment, provided eligibility criteria are met. The approval is valid for one year from the date the first issue opens. The Company must upload issue details on the electronic book platform within one working day of allotment. This approval does not constitute clearance of the document or guarantee of listing.
